title: AnimWeb-Bench: Benchmarking Animated Webpage Code Generation from Videos
reasons: 新基准贡献、任务、评分协议、模型比较及资源线索达到自动筛选门槛；资源内容尚未核实

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To fill this gap, we introduce AnimWeb-Bench, the first benchmark for animated webpage code generation from videos.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Yet existing webpage code generation benchmarks target static screenshots, user-triggered interactions, or isolated motion graphics, leaving the ability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and coding agents to reconstruct complete animated webpages largely unexplored.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We further propose a human-aligned, two-dimensional evaluation protocol: Static Appearance Fidelity measures structure, text, color, and visual similarity on aligned keyframes, while Animation Fidelity tracks UI components across frames and compares their position, size, velocity, and appearance with those in the reference video.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We further propose a human-aligned, two-dimensional evaluation protocol: Static Appearance Fidelity measures structure, text, color, and visual similarity on aligned keyframes, while Animation Fidelity tracks UI components across frames and compares their position, size, velocity, and appearance with those in the reference video.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: It comprises 124 real-world webpages spanning 7 application domains and 33 animation types, with 91.9% of pages combining multiple types, each paired with a reference video and the static assets of the original webpage.
